title: WordPress skill gates never pass a cell nobody measured: a declared no-dark source closes dark cells only on a fresh contract with a light pass in the same run, a sweep that read no cell exits non-zero even with no route, and release refuses such a sweep
steps: S1: In vendor/wordpress/tracy-wordpress-theme/skills/tracy-wordpress-theme run: npm ci, then node --test --test-reporter=tap scripts/test/group-verdict.test.mjs scripts/test/quickstart-release.test.mjs scripts/test/site-sweep-behaviour.test.mjs scripts/test/visual-contract.test.mjs
S2: Read the result of each test named below.
expect: 'a dark axis whose source has no dark of its own is closed only by the contract's source.darkDerived' passes.
'behaviour pass: dark cells the sweep closed on the source's declared lack of dark pass only with the contract's source.darkDerived' passes.
'behaviour pass: a sweep that read no cell of the behaviour checks is refused' passes.
'a sweep that measured no cell never exits 0, even with no route at all' passes.
'the page-map's declaration that the source has no dark of its own is carried as source.darkDerived' passes.
'source.darkDerived stands only on a contract fresh for the spec-pack being read' passes.

selectors.function: scripts/visual/site-sweep.mjs runSweep exit; scripts/visual/group-verdict.mjs; scripts/quickstart/release.mjs behaviour pass; scripts/visual/contract.mjs source.darkDerived

evidence: JA Restaurant WP release (21/10/2026): dark cells of a source with no dark switch stayed owed forever (S-32/S-40), and the first repair let a dark-only or zero-route sweep that measured nothing exit 0.
fence: The skill's sweep exit code, group verdict and release gate decisions for unmeasured and declared-not-owed cells. Pure node tests plus a local test server; no stand, no model.
